title: Counit-normalized exact model of completed scalar extension
statement: For every finite l-adic coefficient extension and scheme W, completedTensorModel is the canonical isomorphism from pbcDerivedExtend of the completed coefficient map to the exact derived localization of pbcExtend, determined by the left-derived computation counit.
